form:FormGroup.helpText: Once data is older than the condense age, merges redundant entries for the same key to reduce store size: only the first of a run of identical values is kept, and overlapping or adjacent sessions are joined. Untick it while loading old or late-arriving data. Default is unticked.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Merges repeated values or touching sessions once data passes the condense age.

form:FormGroup.label: Condense Age
form:FormGroup.helpText: How old data must be before it is condensed. Enter a number from 1 to 9999 and choose Days, Weeks, Months or Years. Default is 1 day. Only used when condense is enabled.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Number from 1 to 9999 and a unit, days to years. Default is 1 day.
